name: http-cache-semantics
description: Local patch of http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 for GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp (max-stale serving security-zeroed shared-cache entries). Versioned 4.2.1, not a prerelease: make-fetch-happen depends on ^4.1.1, which does not match 4.2.1-aerol.1, and npm ci then rejects the bundled lockfile entry. 4.2.1 satisfies that range and is outside the advisory (<= 4.2.0). This is not an upstream release. Drop this pin when a fixed release is on npm.
